name: Tjenestegutten
description: The clever farmhand who engineers a wager and orchestrates a series of misunderstandings to expose the wife’s secret.
visualPrompt: A young Norwegian farmhand in simple wool and linen work clothes, lean and quick-eyed, with a sly half-smile; practical boots, tousled hair, and an alert posture that suggests he is always listening and plotting.

name: Kjærringen
description: The wife who favors Paal Andrestuen and is provoked into a public confession through the farmhand’s tricks.
visualPrompt: A middle-aged rural Norwegian woman wearing a plain dress and apron, hair covered with a kerchief; expressive face that shifts from irritation to panic, clutching her apron as if hiding food, moving with hurried, guilty energy.

name: Den døve Manden
description: The good-natured, deaf husband who follows others’ lead and unwittingly becomes part of the farmhand’s scheme.
visualPrompt: A sturdy, weathered Norwegian farmer with a broad build and calm, puzzled expression; simple work shirt and trousers, rough hands, carrying an axe as a farm tool, standing slightly apart as if missing what others are saying.

name: Paal Andrestuen
description: The favored young man from the other room whose secret visits spark the farmhand’s elaborate prank.
visualPrompt: A young Norwegian man in modest rural clothing, slightly better-kept than a laborer; anxious eyes and tense shoulders, poised to flee, with the look of someone caught between desire and fear.
